sample_unit: patients (primary modeling cohort; external validation n=2820 survey respondents)

links.outcome: Model performance (AUC) across race/ethnicity strata to assess algorithmic bias
links.effect: Final 30-predictor model had overall AUC of 0.68 and remained robust within different race/ethnic strata; no subgroup performance gap reported in the abstract.
links.quote: The model remained robust within different race/ethnic strata.

unlisted_practices: Using a predictive model to prioritize patients for proactive social needs screening and outreach
Setting risk output thresholds by target-population prevalence to optimize positive predictive value

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively validates a predictive risk model for self-reported social risk (SDOH) using EHR and census data, and examines algorithmic bias across racial/ethnic groups and performance at defined risk thresholds, but does not deploy the model or test a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
